svg.aria-label: Three views of 731 daily observations. The dashed line separates training and testing; scatter colors identify the year and temperature retains the dataset normalization; bars compare weekday means. Data: H. Fanaee-T, UCI Bike Sharing, CC BY 4.0. Calculated by the accompanying code.
